messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a fun creative drawing task. I need to produce a valid SVG with a pelican (big bill, pouch, bird body) sitting on a bicycle (two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals). Let me design it carefully with coordinates.

Let me plan a canvas ~400x400.

Bicycle: two wheels at y=320, radius 45. Left wheel center (110, 320), right wheel center (310, 320). Frame lines connecting them, seat post, handlebars.

Pelican: body sitting above frame around center (200, 220), long bill with pouch pointing forward-right, wing, legs to pedals.

Let me write the SVG with:
- Wheels: circles with stroke, spokes maybe simple lines.
- Frame: polygon-ish lines: bottom bracket at (210,320), seat tube from (170,235) to (210,320), down tube from handlebar (300,240) to (210,320), top tube, head tube, handlebars.
- Pelican body: ellipse at (180,215), neck curve, head circle ~ (255,150), bill long triangle with pouch curve.
- Wing shape.
- Leg line down to pedal.

Let me define coordinates concretely.

Wheels: cx 110 cy 330 r 45; cx 320 cy 330 r 45. Stroke black, fill none. Spokes: a few lines.

Frame: rear hub (110,330) to seat junction (185,250) — seat stay. Bottom bracket (215,330). Seat tube (185,250)-(215,330). Down tube from head tube bottom (290,275) to (215,330). Top tube (185,250)-(290,260). Head tube (290,260)-(295,285). Fork: (295,285) to front hub (320,330). Handlebars: from (290,260) up to (300,235) then horizontal bar. Seat: small ellipse at (180,240).

Pelican: sits on seat. Body ellipse center (195,215) rx 45 ry 35. Tail feathers back-left. Neck: from body front-right up to head at (265,155). Head circle r 16 at (268,152). Bill: from head pointing right-down: upper mandible line to (340,175), pouch curve below from (280,170) bulging down to (340,175). Eye dot.

Wing: shape on body.

Legs: from body bottom (200,250) to pedal at bottom bracket area: pedal at (215,330) with crank. Draw leg line with knee bend to foot on pedal.

Also maybe the pelican holds handlebars — wing reaching to handlebar (300,235)? Could draw a line from body to handlebar as wing/arm.

Add crank and pedal: line from (215,330) to (230,315) pedal, and other crank.

Chain optional.

Let me write clean SVG code. Use groups with stroke attributes.

Bill pouch: path M 282 158 L 345 178 Q 320 200 285 172 Z approximate — pouch hanging below bill. Upper mandible: from head (280,150) to tip (345,178). Lower mandible with pouch: from (282,165) curve down to tip.

Head circle at (270,152) r 17.

Neck path: M 235 195 Q 250 170 265 155 ... draw as thick stroke or as shape with two curves. Simpler: stroke line width 14 color same as body fill to look like neck.

Body fill light gray/white (#f0f0f0) with dark outline.

Wing: path like M 160 210 Q 190 240 230 215 Q 210 205 195 200 Z with feather lines.

Tail: small triangles at left (145,205).

Legs: two lines stroke black width 4: from (200,245) to (212,290) to (222,318). Foot on pedal.

Handlebar: path M 290 258 L 298 232 L 318 232.

Also pelican arm/wing reaching handlebar: line from (240,215) to (298,235) stroke width 10? That could be wing-as-arm. But we already have wing on body. Maybe use the wing drawn as reaching toward handlebars. Let's keep simple: small arm line from body front to handlebar.

Chain: line between gears: chainring circle at (215,330) r 12; rear cog circle at (110,330) r 8; chain lines top and bottom.

Wheels spokes: 4 lines each through center.

Let me produce final SVG ~ width 450 height 400. Add ground line optional.

I'll output the code block and brief description. Keep response focused.
